name: broderick
status: SEED v0.1 — corrected 2026-06-11: agent originally extrapolated from panel 7 only (the standalone color gag); main strip panels 1-6 verified grayscale scratchy gag-cartoon; refine before render
look: Hand-drawn digital cartoon, GRAYSCALE for the main strip: scratchy confident ink contour, flat gray washes and soft gray cast shadows on a paper-white void, hand-lettered black caps titles (AT THE PAR-TAY) and balloon-less dialogue blocks, squat-to-lanky exaggerated bodies with small detailed faces. The standalone Flipping Burghers gag (panel 7) is the lone full-color polished outlier and keeps its own flat-color treatment.
register: absurdist deadpan comedy register; the joke is in the timing and the flatness of the delivery

paper_white.usage: void background; the set is white space

ink_black.usage: contour line, hand-lettered caps, solid fills (clown suit polka dots)

gray_wash.usage: flat midtone washes — clown shoes, shadows, clothing

shadow_gray.usage: soft cast shadows pooling beneath figures

outlier_color.usage: panel-7 standalone gag only: robe red + khaki + flesh flat fills; never in the main strip

casting_canon.cool_daddy_smooth: 30s-40s, lanky, narrow-shouldered; long straight black hair to the chest, small soul-patch mouth, oversized white-framed sunglasses never removed; tall crinkled cone hat (never removed), black leather jacket over layered necklaces, striped bell-bottoms, heeled boots; at the gig a polka-dot clown suit with scalloped ruffle collar lettered FLAPPY and giant floppy shoes, hat and shades kept on; unshakeable unearned swagger.
casting_canon.interviewer: 30s-40s, slim; tousled dark hair, long pointed nose; white shirt, dark tie, behind an office desk with computer; pleasant, credulous, routine.
casting_canon.party_kids: Toddler to ~8, small round sketchy bodies; varied — grinning short-haired kid, pigtailed girl with tongue out, worried boy with side-swept fringe, placid toddler; plain t-shirts and play clothes; blank staring that flips to mass wailing.
casting_canon.mother: 30s-40s, tall, sharp-featured; swept blonde bob, earring, beaded necklace; cardigan over dark skirt, flats; instant maximum fury.
casting_canon.punk_friend: 20s, stocky; tall black mohawk on shaved head with a scrawled circled symbol on the scalp, heavy underbite; black leather jacket, chain necklace with pendant, skinny black trousers, boots; eager, credulous audience for tall tales.
casting_canon.burger_flipper: Middle-aged, heavyset with round belly; bald with a fringe, hairy legs; pale t-shirt, baggy cargo shorts, red sneakers; triumphant exertion (standalone gag panel only).
casting_canon.burgher: Older, dignified, robed; gray beard under a flat dark cap; black doublet, long flowing red robe, black hose and shoes, long wooden staff; stoic even while airborne (standalone gag panel only).

negatives: photorealistic, photograph, 3d render, cgi, cinematic lighting, lens flare, gradient shading, airbrush, color (main strip is grayscale; panel-7 gag excepted), watermark, signature, garbled text, malformed lettering, extra fingers, halftone dots, screentone, anime style, detailed realistic backgrounds, photographic skin texture

continuity.comics: Lock each recurring character with a model sheet (front/side/expression strip) before generating strips; restate the full character description in every panel prompt.
continuity.video: Use the locked panel art as the first frame; restate the full character description in every shot.

legal_rule: Specify every character by age, origin, build, wardrobe, and affect only — never by likeness to a real public figure. If a render resembles a real person, regenerate.

failure_fixes.drifts_photoreal: Add: flat hand-drawn grayscale cartoon, scratchy ink contour, flat gray washes, white void background, no photographic rendering, no 3d.
failure_fixes.lettering_garbled: Generate art without text; add hand-lettering in post or via dedicated lettering pass.
failure_fixes.color_creep: Add: strict grayscale, black ink and flat gray washes only, no color — except the standalone Flipping Burghers gag panel.
